title: @npmcli/move-file is deprecated
summary: npm states that @npmcli/move-file functionality moved to @npmcli/fs.

constraints: Preserve overwrite, cross-device fallback, directory creation, permissions, error propagation, and platform-specific move behavior.

steps.title: Move to @npmcli/fs
steps.instructions: Replace the dependency and imports with the move-file functionality exposed by @npmcli/fs, adapting changed exports and options.

verification.purpose: Run same-device, cross-device, overwrite, failure, and repository tests.
